folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B296: full granular owner and later search consumer
folds.body:
The complete original 310-line dossier was reviewed, including G1–G5, every native mismatch, reference/wishlist row, book extension, Corc round and final CRL52 native follow-through. The October2 source revision, 54 tests and nine probe inconsistencies remain historical evidence with direct-import versus extracted-body/synthetic bindings distinguished. The probe command is a reproduction reference, not a request to run it. Later source and delivered consumers in [engine history](ENGINE_EXPANSION.md) qualify old absence/defect claims; this pass establishes no current calendar, recipe, medicine, access or clock bug. The retired first-realm/prestige prerequisite, mandatory human gate, broad legacy compatibility and old source registry are not current authority.

Preserve the actual five-way chain: a body can detect something without interpreting it; a correct diagnosis need not supply a remedy, materials, permission, timely arrival or another person's belief. HP recovery is not proof of removed injury/cause, and absent smell does not erase physical residue. Chronic/temporary conditions need the mechanism that actually ends them. Negative health-loss stat convention is not an inverted-damage bug without its consumer calculation. An evaluator's supplied known flag is not actor discovery; a map/appraisal/translation UI cannot grant rights or hidden truth. Local scripts, copied methods, retained learning and current fuel/body/tool access remain separate.

G3/G4 retain owned exact inputs, tools distinct from ingredients, custody/access, local substitution and current source/body/site. A report or successful recipe name is not a real output consumer. Preserve committed partial work and actual consumed versus reserved stock through interruption; an atomic craft stays atomic. Clock stops return unspent advancement before dependent publication rather than pretending an already advanced native calendar was stopped afterward. Same-time ordering, expiry versus treatment, time sampled at commitment versus ongoing exposure and missing old clock enrollment need their selected owner. None of the laboratory proposal's forfeit, timing or no-offline defaults settles every world or every body.

G5's read model should explain the actual known cost, useful next means and settled result without awarding on render/load. Rendering, display filtering and capped prose are not claim/recipe settlement authorities. Performance ideas remain unmeasured in the October2 investigation; a later bounded benchmark or search consumer does not prove a population simulator. The six primary-page comparisons and three optional text questions remain qualified: publisher synopsis is not a precise recipe, clinical rule or complete source adaptation, and available tutorial images were not inspected merely because linked. No full-book acquisition is needed to retain an explicitly original mechanism.

Useful books may give a clue, external instructions, another earned interpretation or cultural pleasure without compulsory quizzes or page clicking. Consult/reread is separate from replaying the original completion reward, while a genuinely new supported application can earn its own record. Author boasts, narrator humor and character knowledge have different voices; no art or joke quota follows. Current prose-first optional illustration and independent panes qualify old presentation expectations. Current book-world/menu priority leaves Frontier/Mistglass as existing test beds, not new depth targets.

The final CRL52 entry reports an actual local search consumer: visual work changes to slower supported touch as light/support changes, relighting restores the rate and performed progress remains. Its five units, 1/0.5 rates and threshold are reversible local dials, not a global detector or mandatory failure in darkness. That bounded delivery qualifies the preceding proposed investigation paragraph without implementing all recovery, fall/catch, supply, book, humor or condition ideas. Its rebuilt lamp-expiry/discovery and pending/final persistence evidence retains the linked continuation's inputs/date; no browser, save or source is newly examined here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B296: scope of the existing making rules
folds.body:
All MR1–MR36 and both existing application overrides were reviewed against the full [granular owner](GRANULAR_SYSTEMS_AND_INTERACTIONS.md). This is application of the existing rules under AD38, not new product rules or adoption of every linked palette example. Truth and observer knowledge remain separate; actual mechanisms, exact conserved inputs and real downstream readers decide what a made thing does. A blind experiment may work without a prediction, and preview remains read-only and observer-safe.

Read MR14's directional compatibility together with MR1/MR6/MR11 and AD38: actual imported source/body/material/environment mechanisms determine behavior. Unknown development coverage or a missing explicit tag is not a fictional prohibition when the modeled means reasonably work. Keep unsupported integration honestly developer-labelled, and keep inert/active outcomes local rather than erasing ownership/knowledge. MR20's declared magical input is its actual supported capacity/cost policy, not a universal extra fee on an intrinsically free faculty. MR26's sourced scarcity/timing describes its ordinary canon case; exceptions retain their actual source or in-world reason and cost, without inventing a balancing tax.

MR22 distinguishes replaying the same observation/settlement from another meaningful attempt, paid practice, teaching or demonstration. A genuine repeat craft can earn its supported native practice/output; loading or repeatedly inspecting one result cannot grant that attempt again. MR18/MR19 comfort/depth modes use the same applicable resolver and actual maker knowledge, not a separate easier law or a compulsory novelty tax. MR23 shares applicable mechanism/accounting while the particular maker's tools, body, source, access and world still matter.

The existing October18 text already protects performed stages, spent inputs, held stock and intermediates through interruption. It also explicitly qualifies MR30/MR33's old-content/old-save guarantees by current compatibility direction. Do not revive an all-historical-save migration requirement from the table; current selected state still needs consistent references and actual current-format save/reload/import proof when affected. MR34's deterministic checks and MR35's canon-boundary checks use AD36's relevant evidence selection, not a new unrelated runtime suite for a documentation pass. MR36 follows the existing AD43 floor and current desktop/text targets. No new MR code, runtime/save behavior, compatibility policy, source law or acceptance is created by this review.
